raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Bumps [flash-attn](https://github.com/Dao-AILab/flash-attention) from 2.8.3 to 2.8.3.post2.
Release notes

Sourced from flash-attn's releases.

v2.8.3.post2

Maintenance release of FlashAttention 2 on top of v2.8.3.post1. No kernel feature changes.

  • Backport #2622: torch.load(..., weights_only=True) in flash_attn/utils/distributed.py and flash_attn/models (CVE-2026-31253 / GHSA-7g5w-pq96-8c5w). #2974
  • Backport #2702: safe tarfile extraction in hopper/setup.py (CVE-2026-62239 / GHSA-w9r7-4gwr-j959). #2974
  • Backport #2260: fix int32 overflow in the FA2 backward dq_accum offsets, which caused an illegal memory access or NaN gradients when batch * round128(seqlen_q) * nheads * headdim exceeded 2^31 (#2987). #2994
  • setup.py: request cu13 prebuilt wheels for CUDA 13 torch.

v2.8.3.post1

No release notes provided.

Commits
  • 49774b3 Fix int32 overflow (#2260) (#2994)
  • fa74eb7 Release 2.8.3.post2: backport weights_only=True torch.load fix (CVE-2026-3125...
  • ae13dfa fix(setup): request cu13 prebuilt wheels for CUDA 13 torch
  • See full diff in compare view

files.patch:
@@ -75,7 +75,7 @@ verl-core = [
 
 # Pins flash-attn once for the fsdp / megatron parents (wheelhouse-routed below).
 # Don't install alone — needs the parent extra's torch / cuDNN pins.
-flash-attn-cu130torch213 = ["flash-attn==2.8.3"]
+flash-attn-cu130torch213 = ["flash-attn==2.8.3.post2"]
 
 # Pins cupy once for the fsdp / megatron parents. Two unrelated consumers, both
 # on the training side: `ray.util.collective`'s NCCL backend is cupy-based, so
